hero.alt: A member of the Enduraw team between two ASICS athletes in a race finish area
hero.title: A sport performance laboratory
hero.lead: Understanding yourself as an athlete and as a person is what takes performance to the next level. We start from the data to get there.

story.title: Born in Chamonix
story.text: It started in a bedroom in Chamonix, where Joseph Mestrallet spent his nights building pacing plans from the course profile and the conditions. The Enduraw Report followed, then the dashboard.

milestones.launch: Official launch of the Enduraw Report
milestones.v2: Second version: a formula fitted to your data, with cycling and trail running added
milestones.dashboard: The report becomes a full dashboard
milestones.pacing: Pacing plans arrive in the dashboard

team.title: Engineers and sport scientists
team.text: Physics, data science, nutrition, finance and imagery: a small team based in Chamonix.
team.label: The Enduraw team

bios.joseph: From his bedroom in Chamonix, Joseph spent night to build the perfect pacing plans by analyzing race profile and environmental conditions.
bios.anthony: Anthony leads Enduraw's overall strategy and day-to-day operations, backed by a Ph.D. in physics and a deep passion for performance science.
bios.lucas: Lucas oversees Enduraw's financial management and structures its growth, ensuring the financial stability needed to support the team's ambitions.
bios.valentin: Valentin leads the dashboard's technical development: he designs the product architecture, coordinates the technical teams, and ensures the platform's reliability.
bios.charline: An engineer by training, Charline brings her expertise in fueling strategies and energy optimization directly to the service of athlete performance.
bios.antoine: Passionate about performance analysis, he brings valuable experience from his time at Tudor Cycling, at the heart of professional road cycling.
bios.kyllian: Kyllian puts his scientific expertise at the service of athlete performance, combining thorough data analysis with rigorous, hands-on field follow-up.
bios.alex: Dedicated to creating professional, impactful visuals, he captures the essence of Enduraw, its athletes, and its events through striking imagery.
